name: Sumiya
source:
The number one girl at Haven, she is favored by the customers for her feisty attitude and cute looks. She has such a fanbase that many of her regulars have taken to calling her “the Little Tigress”. That spirited personality is merely a façade, however – a fabrication brought on by a special necklace she wears while working that helps her to be more confident and strong-willed.
In reality, Sumiya is actually quite timid and nervous, unable to converse normally with others without the necklace’s aid. Being a university student, she is one of the younger members of the club, though she is hardly lesser for it. Sumiya is what many would call “book smart”, possessing a great range of knowledge that allows her to engage with her customers about numerous topics (but only with the necklace on).
This inability to express herself without help is her greatest source of shame, lacking the natural confidence that seems to come so easily to others. But with your help, she might just be able to overcome it!
[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250128235727/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.chabakura]Google Play[/url]]
